name: Incline Prone Rear Delt Raise
cues: Set the bench to a low incline and lie chest down
Let the dumbbells hang below your shoulders
Raise your arms out wide until they line up with your body
Keep your chest on the pad and lower slowly

qa.note: Wave 3a 2026-10-08: rated minor, owner review. minor: At the top the upper arm is at 86 deg to the trunk and 2 deg off the coronal plane (a true T), palm facing the pad (pronated). It hangs at 45/45 deg (vertical) and retracts the shoulder blades by 15 deg (clavicle protraction +2.9 to -11.9). The only issue is the 45 deg bench against the cue's 'low incline' (lead decision). Foot target error is a constant 3.2/5 mm, with no sliding.
